description: Main-window capability. Grants, each with its justification: dialog:allow-open — the folder picker (open only, no save dialogs). opener:allow-reveal-item-in-dir — 'Reveal in Finder' on a scanned item; selects the file in Finder via NSWorkspace, mutates nothing. opener:allow-open-url — scoped to the x-apple.systempreferences: scheme only, to open the Full Disk Access pane when a scan hits permission walls; no web URLs can be opened. clipboard-manager:allow-write-text — 'Copy path' / 'Copy delete command' put text ON the clipboard; read access is deliberately not granted. No filesystem read/write access is granted through Tauri APIs at all: filesystem READS happen only inside the app's own Rust commands, and nothing in the app can write, move, delete, or execute anything.
